title: Set Up GitHub Actions CI/CD for Node.js App

steps.label: Add npm ci + npm run lint + npm test job on every push
Cache node_modules via actions/cache keyed on package-lock.json hash
Add Codecov upload step using coverage/lcov.info artifact
Create separate cd.yml triggered on tag push v*.*.*
Build and push Docker image to GHCR with semver tag
Add deploy job that ssh-es into staging and runs docker compose pull
Configure required status checks on main branch protection
